apps.name: tap-late
apps.subtitle: Translate Chinese shopping screenshots
apps.localizedDescription: Open a screenshot from Photos or a Shortcut to translate Chinese text into English on your iPhone. Tap a region to read its translation or convert a price between CNY, PLN, USD and EUR. Recent screenshots are grouped in local history.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 33 adds dated offline price conversion, grouped local history and Apple High Fidelity retranslation.
